resources.string: Export saved to the selected document.
Backup restored. Check your current IN / OUT state.
Your local treatment records have been deleted.
Your records are saved. Reminder scheduling needs another try; reopen the app to retry.
Keep a clear record of your aligner routine. Your data stays on this phone, with no account, ads or subscription.
Enter the plan given by your dental professional. This app records your routine; it does not decide when you should change trays.
Daily totals use this fixed zone, including when you travel.
Are your aligners in or out?
Tracking starts now. Earlier hours today will remain untracked.
Check your plan: use whole tray numbers, a positive interval, 0–24 hours (greater than zero), and valid dates in order, no later than today. Use a valid time zone such as Europe/Rome.
Already have a backup? Restore it
Untracked hours are unknown, not missed wear. Today is still in progress.
Forgot a tap? Correct its time in History.
Tracking has stopped. Your schedule, history and exports remain available.
Dates are estimates. Follow your dental professional’s instructions and record each tray change yourself.
Showing the next 12 trays. Later dates follow the same interval.
Confirm only when you have actually changed trays, following your prescribed plan. Today becomes the new tray’s start date, and future estimates move with it.
Only confirm when your dental professional says this phase is complete. Tracking stops now and this treatment becomes read-only. Export your records before starting a future phase.
Enter a valid date from 1970-01-01 through today.
No tracked time on this date.
No state changes on this date. Tracking may continue from the previous day.
Tracking began · this first timestamp is fixed
Enter when this change actually happened, in %1$s. It must stay between its neighbors and cannot be in the future.
Choose a valid time between neighboring changes and no later than now. For a repeated time, choose an occurrence.
Includes today’s partial day. Only days with tracked time contribute to the recorded-wear average.
Complete days meeting their recorded target: %1$d; fully tracked days: %2$d
Targets apply to their historical dates. Partial days do not count as missed goals.
Keep recording to build your history. No data is counted before tracking began.
Use your prescribed target. Changes apply tomorrow; earlier targets stay unchanged.
Enter a whole number from 1 to 1440 minutes.
Remind me on tray change day
Once per tray, at 09:00 on the due date in your treatment zone.
Optional Android alarm access can improve timing. Tracking works without it.
Enter a break delay from 1 to 240 minutes.
App notifications are allowed. Individual channels can still be muted.
Notifications are blocked. Tracking still works; enable notifications to receive reminders.
Precise alarm access is unavailable. Reminders use approximate timing.
Android may delay reminders. Force-stopping the app prevents delivery until you reopen it. Reminders never change your tray or IN / OUT state.

Everything is saved locally. Complete ZIP backups and CSV exports are unencrypted and contain treatment history; an encrypted backup is protected by the password you choose. Save exports somewhere you trust. A document provider may upload them if you choose cloud storage.
Restoring replaces all treatment records on this phone. It does not merge data. Your current reminder preferences remain. Export your existing records first if you need to keep them.
This file contains your treatment history. Anyone with access to the saved file can read it. Choose a trusted location in the system file picker.
Your plan and recorded history will be permanently removed from this app, and reminders will be turned off. Files you exported elsewhere are not deleted.
Free and open source. No account, advertising or analytics. Your phone’s screen lock helps protect your local records.
Android could not open the requested settings or document picker.
Break reminder channel is blocked. Enable it in notification settings.
Tray reminder channel is blocked. Enable it in notification settings.
Changes take effect when you tap Save reminders.
